notes.title: Game is nearly done
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone, [/p][p]there's good news and bad news! Let's start with the good news: [b]Erzperium is nearly finished[/b] the final feature has been implemented and tested. I'm still making a few small adjustments and need to complete the English translation, which shouldn’t take much longer.[/p][p]Now for the bad news... At the moment, I’m having trouble implementing [b]Steam Achievements[/b]. I’ll look for help in the forums, and if necessary, I’ll add the achievements later on.[/p][p]Thanks for your patience![/p]
